parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance.

> If you set this parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify the **NodeId** parameter.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time and within 24 hours from the start time. Otherwise, the query fails.

parameters.name: LogicalOperator
parameters.description:
The logical relationship among multiple keywords.

- **or**

- **and** (default value)

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
The ID of the mongos node or shard node whose operational logs you want to query in the instance. If the instance is a sharded cluster instance, you must specify this parameter.

> This parameter is valid only when **DBInstanceId** is set to the ID of a sharded cluster instance.

parameters.name: OrderType
parameters.description:
The order of time in which the operational log entries to return are sorted. Valid values:

- asc: The log entries are sorted by time in ascending order.

- desc: The log entries are sorted by time in descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **30** to **100**.

parameters.name: QueryKeywords
parameters.description: The keywords used for query. You can enter up to 10 keywords at a time. If you enter multiple keywords, separate the keywords with spaces.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: RoleId
parameters.description: The role ID of the node. You can call the [DescribeReplicaSetRole](~~62134~~) operation to query the role ID.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The role of the node whose error logs you want to query in the instance. Valid values:

- **primary**

- **secondary**

> If you set the **NodeId** parameter to the ID of a mongos node, the **RoleType** parameter must be set to **primary**.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-running-log-records --db-instance-id dds-bpxxxxxxxx --node-id d-bpxxxxxxxx --start-time 2019-01-01T12:10Z --end-time 2019-01-01T13:10Z --db-name mongodbtest --role-type primary --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --order-type asc --resource-group-id sg-bpxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx --role-id 651xxxxx --query-keywords test_test2 --logical-operator and --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dds DescribeRunningLogRecords --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime '2019-01-01T13:10Z' --PageSize 30 --ResourceGroupId 'sg-bpxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' --QueryKeywords test_test2 --RoleType primary --LogicalOperator and --StartTime '2019-01-01T12:10Z' --RoleId 651xxxxx --OrderType asc --DBInstanceId 'dds-bpxxxxxxxx' --PageNumber 1 --NodeId 'd-bpxxxxxxxx' --DBName mongodbtest
